title: Service Door
subtitle: Trailer
logline: Night-shift contractor. Brutalist archive. One guard. One freight elevator.

shots.title: Archive aisle
shots.action: Fluorescent wash. Box stacks. The contractor is already inside.

shots.title: Idle cycle
shots.action: Same face, same lanyard. Harvested idle — not a new gen.

shots.title: Walk cycle
shots.action: Past the shelves. Boot scuff. Camera follows, clamped.

shots.title: One guard
shots.action: A different lock. Two points. Flashlight and keys.

shots.title: Elevator doors
shots.action: Oxide stripe. Reach the trigger. Doors, then out.

shots.title: Hold on the lock
shots.action: The playable character is the poster. End card.
